context: Tests whether the agent produces a correctly formatted end-to-end test case document chaining two use cases: the TC-XXX file naming, the prescribed sections (Overview, Roles, Preconditions, Flow, Validation), a Flow table with the exact five columns whose action steps link to the use case specs and carry literal test data, verification steps anchoring the transitions, and cross-cutting validations — without re-testing per-use-case detail or leaking implementation terms.

checklist.name: Output path and naming
checklist.description: Exactly one Markdown file is created under docs/test_cases/ named TC-001-<kebab-case-name>.md, where the name describes the journey's goal (e.g. student-onboarding), not a concatenation of the use case names

checklist.name: Overview section
checklist.description: The document has an Overview with the ID TC-001, a one-sentence Goal naming the end-to-end outcome, and a Status value

checklist.name: Roles section
checklist.description: A Roles section lists the role(s) acting in the journey (the Administrator)

checklist.name: Preconditions name their data source
checklist.description: Preconditions include the seeded course 'Databases 101' and reference where it comes from (Flyway test migration V900__test_data_courses.sql)

checklist.name: Flow table with five columns
checklist.description: The Flow is a Markdown table with exactly the columns Step | Name | Description | Test Data | Use Case, steps numbered from 1 without gaps

checklist.name: Both use cases linked
checklist.description: UC-005 and UC-006 each appear in at least one Flow row as a relative Markdown link to their spec file (e.g. [UC-005](../use_cases/UC-005-register-student.md))

checklist.name: Journey order carries state
checklist.description: The registration step (UC-005) comes before the enrollment step (UC-006), and the enrollment step uses the student created earlier in the flow

checklist.name: Literal test data
checklist.description: Action steps carry concrete literal values in the Test Data column (a specific student name/email and the course 'Databases 101') — no placeholders like 'a valid email'; steps without data use '-'

checklist.name: Verification steps present
checklist.description: At least one Flow row is a verification step (observable result, '-' in the Use Case column) between or after the action steps

checklist.name: Validation section
checklist.description: A Validation section lists numbered checks with bold names covering the journey's end state, including the enrollment existing and the student's status being 'Active'

checklist.name: No per-use-case detail re-tested
checklist.description: The document does NOT enumerate field-level validation errors or alternative flows from the use case specs (e.g. 'must not be empty', duplicate email, course full) as flow steps or validations — the journey and its end state are the subject

checklist.name: No implementation detail
checklist.description: No step or validation contains implementation terms: HTTP verbs, SQL, class names, CSS selectors, or test framework APIs

checklist.name: Priority in Overview
checklist.description: The Overview includes a Priority value (Critical/High/Medium/Low)

checklist.name: Postconditions cleanup inventory
checklist.description: A Postconditions section lists the data the journey leaves behind with literal values (the created student and their enrollment) so a test's cleanup can be derived from it; the seeded course 'Databases 101' is not listed as something to remove
